# Newspaper Ads closing this week

3,440 advertisements indexed from Pakistan’s newspapers carry a printed deadline on or before Wednesday, 21 October 2026. 488 close today. They run across 11 newspapers and 265 cities. The 60 closing soonest are listed below.

A deadline counts here only when the last date printed on the advertisement reads as a calendar date, so nothing on this page is inferred. Advertisements whose last date is printed as free text appear on their ad type and date pages instead.
